notes.title: Update 0.9.2
notes.content: [h1]0.9.2 Update notes[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/8fe14272dd45ebd3bc8486f537a5b855cfc23b9a.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi everyone! The Ember Guardian is going to Tokyo Game Show 2025 this week, and to prepare for this special occasion, I am pushing a substantial update to the demo, including visual polishing, combat balance, building improvements, and Japanese localization. Here are some highlights of this patch:[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Visuals[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/56ae5a59ff352ee03a5f2646717ed464e129ce89.png"][/img][/p][p]The first thing you will notice right after starting the game: you can now play as a female character, completed with new sounds and animation. You can also switch the player character whenever you like using main menu settings.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/be53b7c02987b4fd88230a584d58ca6942ab220f.png"][/img][/p][p]In addition, The Ember Guardian has a new logo! You can now find it on the main menu, and it matches the ambiance very well![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Combat[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Combat being a core mechanic of The Ember Guardian has always been a focus of community feedback, and I’ve taken this change address some of the issues. To begin with, rolling now no longer cancels reloading and this should make combat a lot more fluid.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/6d1125c4cc96641348f9ccc5ca2da10e63251665.png"][/img][/p][p]Enemies now react to players in a more natural manner – crawlers and wasps do not always immediately swarm the player, allowing more breathing room during combat. But don’t be too comfortable, as crawlers have learnt to flank you from both sides, and the armored slugs can shrug off your bullets with their tough shell.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Buildings[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/0f09d19f602b44baa5a1680ee839f14150bfac08.png"][/img][/p][p]Upgraded towers can now host two hunters to double their firepower. You can also work on buildings during the night, even when you’re under attack. Having the option to build new towers or barricades and even repairing damaged ones should give players more tactical flexibility.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]These are only a few of the numerous updates introduced in this patch, ranging from gameplay balancing to bug fixes. For the full list of changes, you can see the full patch notes below:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Balancing:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Barricades are now fully repairable at night[/p][/*][*][p]Level 2 towers can now host 2 hunters instead of 1 (localization)[/p][/*][*][p]“Slug” type creature’s shell now makes bullets bounce off![/p][/*][*][p]Spam QTE progress/key pressed + 10%[/p][/*][*][p]SMG accuracy debuff when moving and running decreased[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased rifle accuracy when using semi-auto mode[/p][/*][*][p]Crawlers and Wasps chance to aggro player on weapon shoot : 100% → 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Crawlers can now flank the player[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced teleportation skill delay between activation and teleportation : 2s → 1.5s[/p][/*][*][p]Trainer’s Max HP upgrade is now capped at level 3[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added female player character[/p][/*][*][p]New logo! Title screen has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the Hunter Shrine visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Changed fire visuals when fueling it with orbs[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the Eternal Flame’s look[/p][/*][*][p]Added talk lines to the player that replace some of the tool tips[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the SMG visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Improved hunter arrows trajectories & visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Changed gem visuals : newly collected gems now look “raw”, and dropping them in the chest “purifies them”, making them usable for the merchants[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]QOL[/b][/p][list][*][p]Gun chests no longer replace your weapon completely : you can now swap back to your initial weapon using “tab”[/p][/*][*][p]Rolling doesn’t restart the whole reloading process anymore[/p][/*][*][p]Towers & barricades are now upgradable at night[/p][/*][*][p]Paying an orb to fuel the fire now instantly adds fuel (removed the part with the orb falling into fire)[/p][/*][*][p]Doggo now doesn’t growl or bark if set on “Stay” behavior[/p][/*][*][p]Crouching now reduces the player’s collider vertical size[/p][/*][*][p]Improved gamepad aiming (auto aim, gamepad axial deadzone, rest cursor position…)[/p][/*][*][p]Current day displayed every morning[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased SFX volume for shotgun hit sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Added an SFX when player starts changing weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon cursor is now hidden while the player is swapping weapons and cannot shoot[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Surge window:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed surge window stacking[/p][/*][*][p]Damage numbers are blue when under surge window buff[/p][/*][*][p]Crit hit no longer stackable with surge window damage buff[/p][/*][*][p]Added minimum delay of 60s between surges[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Localization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Japanese localization[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Optimization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Creatures far away from player are now set in hibernation[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized audio memory usage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some performance bugs when the backpack was too full of small orbs[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]BugFixes :[/b][/p][list][*][p]Petting dog does not change the dog’s state anymore (follow ↔ stay)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with weapon precision when swapping weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Objective UI correctly displayed at the center of the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed animals die animation looping indefinitely[/p][/*][*][p]Auto aim now also works on wasp nests[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the last bullet of a surged weapon would not deal increased damage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where interacting with a weapon chest while opening would re-trigger the opening SFX & animation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where trap slots would display as buildable even when the player has no traps in his inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a destroyed barricade could be upgraded at night[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the ammo bar would not show when reloading close to the ammo crafter[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed accuracy values drifting during a run[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an animation bug where dying would not turn the player transparent[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p]

notes.title: Slug Disco @ Tokyo Game Shows 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Slug Disco will be returning to Tokyo Game Show from September 25th to the 28th!

The Ember Guardian will be available to play in the Select Indie 80 section of the venue, and we will have 6 more games to play over in the indie area of the show.

The games on show will be:

[list]
[*] Adapt
[*] Green Again
[*] Horticular (with a surprise!)
[*] Strange Seed
[*] Ecosystem
[*] Primordial Empire
[/list]

If you're at the show please come say hello to me (Dan) and Hei Man :)

notes.title: 🎉 10,000 WISHLISTS! 🎉
notes.content: [h3][b]Hello Guardians![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/679fe406e350705089757e67261b7ab849d04231.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The last few months have been pretty crazy for me and The Ember Guardian: demo launch, shooting overhaul, working on new content… the game has come a pretty long way. In July, we've finally passed the 10,000 wishlist mark – a major milestone for an indie game. Thank you to everyone for playing my demo, and shoutout to content creators who shared my game with their communities. I could not have done it without your help (and hundreds of hours of playtime).[/p][p] [/p][p]Knowing that so many of you are waiting to play my game has really motivated me to go all in on development. I’ve been working on a lot of new content, including new weapons, new buildings, new abilities, new upgrades, and even new doggos. While not everything will appear in the demo, I still hope you will look forward to the full game where you can wield the full arsenal against the encroaching darkness. Here are some screenshots for a quick preview on what I've been working on:[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/f23b437f7228a9888d2f3661ca1997d394cafa0c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/9cb747e5825373b2510b87cb0b0d559b31d39721.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/3f7280f4ca20fadc772af12ec47f1751fa18162e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/f64abbb890c52733920990e527d786c3664e33eb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/2669277e757892c833fe0fe0b0f68c826194a679.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p] [/p][p]Starting from next month, I’ll be posting regular Steam blogs (hopefully once every month). Just something to keep everyone updated on development progress and any relevant news of The Ember Guardian. Don't forget to follow me on my socials to get the latest news and some behind-the-scenes devlogs. See you in September![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@RatbitGames" style="button" buttoncolor="#378b76"]YouTube[/url] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@ratbitgames" style="button" buttoncolor="#378b76"]TikTok[/url] [url="https://x.com/RatbitGames" style="button" buttoncolor="#378b76"]X/Twitter[/url][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.9.1
notes.content: [p]An update to rework the gun jamming system, and address some minor issues:[/p][p][/p][h2]Weapon Surge System[/h2][p]After reviewing the previous gun jam system, I have decided to change it into a more rewarding than punishing mechanic. It is now renamed as the [b]Surge System[/b].[/p][list][*][p]The QTE is now optional with a time window[/p][/*][*][p]If the QTE skill check is successfully completed within the window, the next bullets will gain a x2 damage boost[/p][/*][*][p]The “Stability” upgrade (originating from the jam mechanic) is replaced by the “Surge Efficiency” upgrade, increasing the number of bullets buffed after each surge[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]QoL[/h2][list][*][p]Reduced response time when using orbs on buildings and chests[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Balancing[/h2][list][*][p]Added 2 foxes on each side of the main map[/p][/*][*][p]Increased hunter accuracy during the night[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.9.0.5
notes.content: [p]A quick patch of bug fixes, balancing and a QOL change:[/p][p] [/p][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where upgrading weapon damage was resetting the weapon's damage to 0.[/p][list][*][p]A shoutout to streamer [url="https://www.twitch.tv/zevraska/videos "]Zevraska[/url] for discovering this bug[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual bug where a new ammo mag was huge after entering the belt.[/p][/*][/list][p]Balancing[/p][list][*][p]Buff base hunter accuracy: +25%[/p][/*][/list][p]QOL[/p][list][*][p]Added an indicator to the flag when pushed too far for the hunters to make it back to camp before night.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.9
notes.content: [p][b]Hi everyone![/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Demo Update 0.9 is now online![/b] After testing out the new gun play mechanics in the beta branch, they have now made their way into the official demo. Let me know what you think about the changes! If you'd like to share your feedback or suggestions, feel free to join our [url="https://discord.gg/6hqat4NKh4"]Discord[/url] and/or leave a comment on our socials or Steam discussion board.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]0.9 Update notes[/h1][p] [/p][h2]Shooting system overhaul[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/6174bfa65ece7029b732f68ca280169093f3403e.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]New accuracy system[/b]: The reticle has brackets showing your weapon’s accuracy zone.[/p][list][*][p]The aiming point moves within this zone to reflect shot precision, and your shots will always land precisely where the point is located. No more aiming straight at a small creature and missing because of random weapon spread![/p][/*][*][p]The accuracy of your weapon reacts to the following statuses : walking, running, exhausted, crouching, shooting and taking damage.[/p][/*][*][p]You now also feel the difference in weapon weight with their reticle point following the brackets at different speeds.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Reloading simplified[/b]: Adding a clip from your belt to your weapon is now automatically performed when trying to shoot with an empty clip. This behavior can still be turned back to manual in the settings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Jams[/b]: Shooting now has a chance of jamming your weapon, initiating a QTE to repair it. Weapons have different QTE lengths.[/p][/*][*][p]Two new weapon upgrades added: Field Reliability Mod (reduces jam probability) and Quick-Clear Lever (reduces the amount of inputs in jam QTEs[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weak spots[/b]: hitting a creature's weak spot now deal increased flat damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Critical hits[/b]: are now also possible when not hitting a weak spot.[/p][/*][*][p]Added damage numbers: turned on by default, but can be turned off in the settings.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Hunter AI improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Hunters can now take over another hunter’s assigned animal if they are closer to it than the current hunter.[/p][/*][*][p]Hunters can now shoot incoming creatures during dawn[/p][/*][*][p]Added RNG to the Hunter's shots during night attacks[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Spanish localization is now available, thanks to an awesome community member ![/h2][p] [/p][h2]Balancing[/h2][list][*][p]Unlocked the Max Stamina upgrade in the demo ![/p][/*][*][p]Decreased double arsenal mastery price (10 -> 5 green gems)[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Shotgun & SMG prices (8 -> 2 red gems)[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Weapon swap time upgrades by 1 gem[/p][/*][*][p]You now recover stamina much faster when standing still[/p][/*][*][p]Removed shotgun focus blast damage nerf : full focus blast damage 80 -> 120[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]QOL[/h2][list][*][p]Added a new video tip for Gun Jamming[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new video tip for weapon management when buying a new weapon[/p][/*][*][p]Changed tip description from "To open backpack" to "To display backpack"[/p][/*][*][p]Changed tower description in the Gem Merchant's shop to specify damage & range upgrades are specific to the hunters[/p][/*][*][p]Character menu (tab) is now closeable with the ESC key[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Bullets should now bounce way less often when landing.[/p][/*][*][p]Wind sounds are now affected by the SFX volume setting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Demo Completed Video Tip panel layout[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the hub chest would stay open if the player exits its trigger area while the opening animation is running.[/p][/*][*][p]Rolling when crouching now plays the rolling animation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the "?" over the hunter's head being reversed when they flip[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hunters shooting at dead target during night attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where crawlers would stop moving while crossing bridges when attempting to jump[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Tweaks[/h2][list][*][p]Added torches/lights to the wild emberling camps[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the "holding orbs" indicator from the hunters to not overlap with status indicators[/p][/*][*][p]Bullet collision when standing close to a barricade is more permissive.[/p][/*][*][p]Hub Chest sound level reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the Chest & Backpack UI layers behind the shop UI[/p][/*][*][p]Changing weapon panel now has a background, an outline and empty weapon slots[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]I hope you enjoy the features! Follow us on our socials for the latest news on The Ember Guardian![/p][table colwidth="100,,"][tr][td colwidth="100"][p][url="https://discord.gg/6hqat4NKh4" style="button"]Discord[/url][/p][/td][td][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@RatbitGames" style="button"]YouTube[/url][/p][/td][td][p][url="https://x.com/RatbitGames" style="button"]X/Twitter[/url][/p][/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.8.2
notes.content:
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]The boss is no longer affected by the shock trap.
[*]The shock trap's slowing effect no longer stacks.
[/list]
[b]QOL[/b]
[list]
[*]Critical hits now come with enhanced feedback.
[*]Added a sound effect when selecting different trap type to build.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a major bug where the hunters would fire at an invisible target at night.
[*]The weapon icon in the character menu now updates when picking up a new weapon from a chest in the tutorial area.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.8.1
notes.content:
[b]UW Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Windowed mode display now allows resizing the window (5120 x 1440 resolution is not compatible yet)[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]Rifle accuracy : +30%
[*]Summoners and wasp nests now immediately spawn an enemy when the player eliminates a minion, if their max spawned minion number is reached.
[/list]
[b]QOL improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased the visibility of the wasps and of the nest
[*]Time required holding interact to light fire : -50%
[*]Reduced worker waiting time before dropping orbs
[*]Reduced time needed to be able to pick up orbs again when dropped by player 3s → 2s
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the player would drop an orb when collecting ammo from the crafter.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.7.9
notes.content:
[b]Balancing[/b][list]
[*]Reduced Fox HP : 30 -> 20
[/list]
[b]QOL[/b][list]
[*]Weapon chests in the tutorial now fill up the player's ammo belt
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the ammo crafter indicator would remain active in the tutorial
[*]Fixed an issue where the hunters in the tutorial would get out of reach to accomplish the "collect orbs from the hunters" objective
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.7.8
notes.content:
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased melee attack speed by 50%
[/list]
[b]QOL improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Fire's orb drop point slightly lowered
[*]Increased the speed at which an orb is inserted in the ammo crafter
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the player would clip out of the map when petting the dog close to the edge
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.7.7
notes.content:
[b]QOL improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Hold actions (Reload, Pay Orbs) are now way more reactive. Thanks for the feedback, players !
[*]Reduced the time it takes to extract an ember : 5s -> 3s
[*]Trap visibility improved when selecting a trap to place
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]Base player speed : +10%
[*]Shotgun loading focused shot time : -12.5%
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the player could take no action if the dog is close (drop orbs, pay gems)
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.7.6
notes.content:
[b]QOL improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Different Elite creatures now have different outline colors ! Green = speed elite, Red = dmg elite, Yellow = HP elite
[/list][list]
[*]Added "/x" text under upgradeable items to show item's max levels
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] New towers and barricades can now be built during the night. However, you cannot repair/upgrade your barricades during a night attack.
[/list][list]
[*]Buffed player sprint speed (+45% -> +50%)
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
